o.en: If in a virtualenv that has global access, do not list globally-installed packages. (environment variable: PIP_LOCAL)
Only output packages installed in user-site. (environment variable: PIP_USER)
Restrict to the specified installation path for listing packages (can be used multiple times). (environment variable: PIP_PATH)
Select the output format among: columns (default), freeze, or json. The 'freeze' format cannot be used with the --outdated option. (environment variable: PIP_FORMAT)
List packages that are not dependencies of installed packages. (environment variable: PIP_NOT_REQUIRED)
Exclude editable package from output. (environment variable: PIP_EXCLUDE_EDITABLE)
Include editable package in output. (environment variable: PIP_INCLUDE_EDITABLE)
Exclude specified package from the output (environment variable: PIP_EXCLUDE)
